scope: All units read: translation and word glosses against the Telugu text. The text was not compared with the source.

items.issue: చేరి (“having come to”) was rendered as a command, “Come home to Nanda's house”.
మా యన్న is an endearment here; “O elder brother who fathered the Love-god” was odd.
items.change: Now “O our dear one, father of the Love-god”.

items.issue: తిరుపట్ల was rendered “Tirupati”; it is the village Tirupaṭla, as the word gloss has it.
